Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex.

I can see that Alex is 5 years old and doesn't live with you. To assess your eligibility, I need to understand one key detail:

**Are you making regular financial contributions towards Alex's upkeep** (such as for clothes, food, pocket money, or helping to provide somewhere for them to live)?

If yes, can you tell me approximately how much you contribute per week (or per month)? The Child Benefit rate is currently £25.60 per week for the eldest/only child and £16.95 per week for additional children, so for Alex it would be £25.60 per week. To continue receiving Child Benefit when a child lives elsewhere, you generally need to contribute at least as much as the Child Benefit payment.

This information will help me determine whether you meet the criteria for Child Benefit.
